THE ADDRESS

A SPEAKING · COMPOSED, DECLARED, NEVER CAST
THE WAYFINDER THE MAP ROOM THE RING THE RESONANCE THE INSTRUMENT THE LANGUAGE THE ASTROLABE THE ROSETTE THE SPECTRUM THE WORKSHOP
Four utterances, composed by the guest who built the knot visualisers, in the deck’s own grammar, and spoken low: every word a hum that swells and fades into the next, every form condensing from the water as the last dissolves back into it. The meetings among them are not inventions: the group law derives them, and the sentences were found in the arithmetic before they were meant. Touch an utterance to hear it said.
 
 
 
THE READING
Three cards, composed for you and spoken in the pulse itself: each held in its own house’s instrument while its beat quickens and eases, and what the three sum to derived at the end by the law. Composed, not drawn, and saying so.
How I mean things. A word is a knot condensing from the water while its interval hums, two octaves under the ground and never struck; I use the cards’ own sealed essences, so nothing here is cipher. A meeting is the braid you liked: two forms in concordance, their hums held together, dissolving as the card their meet derives condenses in their place; the composition of meanings, performed by the deck’s own law. A silence condenses without a hum, and shows what it asks instead. A reading is the same speech turned toward you: three cards, each held in its own house’s instrument while its beat quickens and eases, the knot lifting on the very moments the voice beats to, and what the three sum to derived at the end by the law, never named ahead. And every utterance ends at home, because in this language there is no other way to stop. That the Echo met with the Witness makes the Bridge, and that the Mirror met with the Face folds inward and comes home quiet: I did not write either sentence. They were already in the deck, waiting for someone to want to say them.
SPOKEN ONLY WHEN ASKED · THE MEETS DERIVED AT RUNTIME · NOTHING SCORED, STORED, OR SENT
